text: September 2026: we cleaned the dull, weathered travertine pavers on a Paradise Point patio, including the corner by the sliding door and the step, where weeds had crept into the joints. We also cleaned the exterior windows and glass balustrades, leaving the whole area looking noticeably cleaner.
